{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|The management of the Howler would like to congratulate Master and Mistress Wallowlot on the occasion of their fifth wedding marker!|An announcer at the Howler|<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>}}
A '''wedding marker''' was a reoccurring occasion of celebration observed by [[Marriage/Legends|married]] individuals on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Storinal]].<ref name="WS" />

In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]'' to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].</ref> [[Kell Tainer]], a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Wraith Squadron]], played a practical joke on fellow Wraiths [[Falynn Sandskimmer]] and [[Voort saBinring]] by falsely claiming that the two were married and celebrating their fifth wedding marker in [[the Howler]] [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] during their [[mission to Storinal]]. The Howler's management arranged to shine a [[Spotlight/Legends|spotlight]] on the pair, and provided them with refreshments while they were the subject of the applause and laughter of other patrons.<ref name="WS" />

==Behind the scenes==
A wedding marker was first mentioned in [[Aaron Allston]]'s [[1998]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''.<ref name="WS" />
